movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Twister
movelist.effect: Small or Medium targets in the central square of the blast are not hit. Twister Flinches the target on 18-20 during Accuracy Check. Any Pokémon Airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop above the Blast are hit, ignoring range, and Twister has a Damage Base of 8 against those targets instead.

movelist.name: Air Slash
movelist.effect: Air Slash Flinches the target on 15+.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.effect: Moves with an Effect Range gain a +10 Bonus to Damage, but Effect Ranges can never be triggered.
